_comment: Google Search Console through a service-account key: hourly search traffic, the pages and queries that moved, the search terms that land on the site, URL Inspection of the pages that matter, and sitemaps. Read-only (webmasters.readonly). docs/google-setup.md is the Google side.
_credentials_comment: The service-account JSON key itself, the whole file pasted here. Get it from the Google Cloud console (console.cloud.google.com). Under APIs & Services → Library, enable the Google Search Console API. Under IAM & Admin → Service accounts, create a service account with no project role, open it, and choose Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. Paste that downloaded file here. In Search Console, pick the property, Settings → Users and permissions → Add user, enter the key's client_email, and choose Restricted. The widget re-mints its hour-long token from the key indefinitely. Empty uses credentials_file; when both are set, this wins. Stored in config.json, which should be chmod 600, and never shown again after it is written. Full steps: docs/google-setup.md.
_credentials_file_comment: Path to the service-account JSON key (~/ is expanded), used when credentials is empty. The file is the JSON downloaded from the Google Cloud console: IAM & Admin → Service accounts → the account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. Enable the Search Console API first, and in Search Console add the key's client_email as a Restricted user under Settings → Users and permissions. The screen warns when that file is readable by anyone but you. Full steps: docs/google-setup.md.
_sites_comment: Properties exactly as Search Console names them: sc-domain:example.com for a domain property, or https://example.com/ with its trailing slash for a URL prefix. Empty reads every property the account can see.
_refresh_comment: Seconds between refreshes, at least 120. Google's data moves hourly at best.
_window_days_comment: Complete days in each movers window, compared with the equal window before it. w switches between 7 and 28 while running.
_inspect_top_comment: How many pages from the movers answer are inspected once a day, the ones with the most impressions, plus as many that dropped to zero. Search Analytics ranks by clicks and stops at 1,000; the INDEX HEALTH header says so when that cut the answer. 0 turns inspection off. Google allows 2,000 inspections a day per property.
_search_type_comment: Which Google results to read: web, image, video, news or discover. t steps through them while running.
